illegal_transition_slots.description: `verification_ready → complete`
`evaluating → verified` with blocked/stale required path
subagent `verified → complete`
revoked verdict remaining complete
GoalRun complete with missing admission/trace/human-decision refs
internal L0–L8 stage exposed as a new public harness
PAC 只映射湖名而未落到 AC/TC/task/evidence/revision/hash
Program freeze 仅依据 promotion status string
fill transaction 任一步缺失、hash 漂移或 recovery 未闭环

acceptance_criteria.description: ClosureMatrix 覆盖 intent/path/AC/state/task/evidence 六层并可双向追溯
Goal pass 要求 must intents covered、required paths closed、AC verified、状态合法、任务终态一致、证据有效
任一 Truth/graph/material/evidence stale 均阻断完成并给出重建 route
subagent/task executor 不能直接完成 GoalRun；只有 Goal owner 在 verifier pass 后转换 complete
fail verdict 必须列出最小未闭环集合及 recommended next-ready/replan/truth/qa route

GoalRun 必须持有 `run_id`、program slug、graph revision、truth revision set、current ready set、human decision refs、admission/worktree refs、`agent_trace.v1` refs 与 verifier refs；任一 required ref 缺失或 stale 均阻断 complete
L0–L8 只能映射到既有 goal→plan→truth→可选 design→implement→qa→release；不得新增 public harness，且 verifier pass 只产生裁决，最终 complete 仍由 Goal owner 执行
Program trace matrix 必须实现 `PAC → lake slug → AC IDs → TC IDs → task/evidence refs → R2/final baseline hash` 全链；任一 PAC 只映射湖名、无 TC、无 evidence 或 hash stale 都阻断 Program freeze
Program freeze 必须逐湖重新执行并验证 package validation pass、Truth Review pass、human ack、R2 revision 与当前四文件 hash 一致、promotion receipt hash-authenticated；不得仅信任 promotion JSON 的 `status=complete`
`truth-fill-transaction.v1` 的 scaffold/request/response/schema/patch/projection/validation/review/human-ack/freeze 步骤必须全部闭合，且 L5 progress 与 L7 recovery refs 可追溯，才可把 package 与 Program 判定 frozen
